info.title: NWS Pinal Forecast
info.description: Read-only 7-day forecasts from the US National Weather Service (api.weather.gov) for two Pinal County, Arizona cotton areas. Public API; no authentication.

get.description: Returns the current National Weather Service 7-day forecast for Maricopa, Arizona (Phoenix office PSR, grid 158,41). The forecast is in properties.periods: 14 half-day periods, alternating day and night. In each period: name (for example Saturday or Saturday Night), isDaytime (true for day periods), temperature (degrees F; the high for day periods, the low for night periods), probabilityOfPrecipitation.value (percent chance of rain), and shortForecast (for example Sunny). properties.updateTime is when the forecast was issued, in UTC.

200.description: GeoJSON forecast. The useful fields are properties.updateTime and properties.periods, described in the operation description.
